case_name: Smt Munugala Divya vs Mr Pendyala Vijay
facts_of_case: Appellant is the wife and respondent is the husband. She has filed a divorce petition seeking dissolution of marriage on grounds of cruelty and unsound suffering from mental disorder. The trial court dismissed the petition.

legal_principles.principle: Parties seeking mutual consent divorce must file an application under Section 13(B) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 before the jurisdictional Family Court.
legal_principles.held: The parties have to file an application under Section 13(B) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 before the jurisdictional Family Court seeking dissolution of marriage with mutual consent.

legal_principles.principle: Conversion of a divorce petition into a mutual consent divorce petition is impermissible.
legal_principles.held: Conversion of the aforesaid FCOP.No.1224 of 2021 into mutual consent divorce petition in the present case is impermissible.

outcome.final_order: Parties granted liberty to file an application under Section 13(B) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 before the jurisdictional Family Court seeking dissolution of marriage with mutual consent. Liberty is also granted to parties to file an application seeking waiving of the six month period.
